 PETALING JAYA: Bermaz Auto Bhd (BAuto) has ceased to be the distributor of XPeng electric vehicles in Malaysia, following plans by the Chinese marque’s owner to reorganise its distribution network in the country.
 In a filing with Bursa Malaysia, BAuto said its 85%-owned subsidiary Bermaz Xpeng Sdn Bhd (BXpeng) had ceased its XPeng operations with immediate effect, while both parties were in the process of finalising the terms for the termination of their existing agreements.
 BXpeng had previously entered into a distributor agreement and a warranty claim agreement with subsidiaries of XPeng Inc, the marque owner and principal manufacturer of XPeng vehicles, covering the distribution, sale of spare parts and provision of after-sales services in Malaysia.
 The agreements were due to expire in March 2027.
 “The parties concerned are currently in the midst of finalising the terms to terminate the XPeng agreements and other ancillary agreements. BXpeng will continue to work with the parties concerned to ensure a smooth transition.”
